guide: Start here: this workbook tracks the papers, contacts and dates of your home. Open Start and type the household name, the trip date and the usual lead time in the yellow cells.

Replace demo data: clear the yellow demo cells of Team, Documents, Contacts, Warranty dates, Vehicle dates, Pet dates, Maintenance due dates, Home routines, Where things are and Key and access list. Keep the lists and settings.
Type your household on Team first: phones and first names are used by every text and by the emergency and sitter sheets.
Calculated sheets (Renewals, Renewals by month, Document status board, Documents by holder, Emergency contact sheet, Sitter sheet): type the rank numbers or the keys once and the rest fills in.
Every document has a typed lead time, the days before the expiry you act. The action date is the expiry minus the lead time; the status reads Act now, Soon, Lead time missed or OK.
Monthly routine: open Renewals next 90 days, read the items past their action date, start the ones with the shortest lead time and tell the owner with a text.
Yearly routine: check every paper on Documents, the places on Storage places and the numbers on the Emergency contact sheet, then write the next review date.
Pick the tool of the question you have: renewals in 90 days, trip documents, action date finder, lead time what-if, contract review, notice period, key check, sitter sheet builder or contact lookup.
Use the 18 tools, print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Sitter sheet: first names of the children, phone numbers you type, school hours, house routines and where things are. No health details are stored or printed anywhere in this workbook.
A single adult uses documents, contacts and renewals unchanged and leaves the children, sitter and school rows empty.
Renters add the tenancy agreement as a Contract with its renewal date and leave the owner-only papers; read a trade as a maintenance request to the landlord.
Intervals and lead times are typical: check the manual, the issuing office and your local rules. Notice periods come from your contract.
Why a workbook: one flat price, no yearly renewal, your data stays with you, nothing to link, no ads and no upsell. It runs in Excel and Google Sheets with no macros, no add-ins and no accounts.
What this is not: not a reminder app, not a safety service, not legal, medical, veterinary or financial advice. Every date and total is calculated from your entries.

listing.title: Documents, Contacts and Renewals Excel Template: Document Expiry Tracker, Renewals Calendar, Sitter Sheet, Emergency Contacts
listing.headline: Track every paper, contact and renewal date of your home in one workbook
listing.description:
Know what expires, when to start and who handles it. Built for a single adult, a couple or a family, owners or renters: papers for the adults and the children, policies and contracts, warranty papers, vehicle and pet dates and the filters and alarms of the house. Every document has its holder, its expiry or renewal date, the place it is kept and a lead time you type: the action date is counted back from the expiry and the status reads Act now, Soon, Lead time missed or OK.

One ranked list gathers the next 90 days from documents, contracts, warranties, vehicle dates, pet dates and maintenance tasks with the owner, the days left and the action date. Renewals by month and by type show the next 12 months, and a status board lists every document by days left.

18 tools answer the questions of every month: do the travel documents last until the trip, when to start a renewal, what changes if the lead time is longer, which contract to review, is there still time to give notice, who holds a key and who handles the renewals. The contacts directory keeps trades, the school, the carpool family and the neighbour with the last time used and the cost line of the last job; the emergency sheet and the one-page sitter sheet print from the same numbers. No health details, ever.

Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to the household, the sitter, the school, the neighbour and the trades.

This is part seven of the eight-part Home Management suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros, no accounts and no yearly renewal, with a demo copy full of sample data and a blank copy. Dates and totals are calculated from your entries and are not advice.

ar.The numbers behind the charts: الأرقام التي تُبنى عليها الرسوم البيانية
ar.Colours: cream-yellow cells, and the whi: الألوان: الخلايا الصفراء الفاتحة والأعمدة البيضاء في الجداول هي التي تكتب فيها، أما الخلايا الرمادية المزرقة الفاتحة فتُحسب لك تلقائياً.
ar.Protection: every sheet is protected, wi: الحماية: كل ورقة محمية بلا كلمة مرور حتى لا تُمسح المعادلات بالخطأ. الخلايا المحسوبة مقفلة، وكل خلية مخصصة لإدخالك تبقى مفتوحة.
ar.To change something that is locked: Revi: لتعديل شيء مقفل: مراجعة > إلغاء حماية الورقة (لا حاجة إلى كلمة مرور)، ويمكنك حماية الورقة مجدداً بعد ذلك إن أردت.
ar.Currency symbol: type it once in the \"C: رمز العملة: اكتبه مرة واحدة في خانة «رمز العملة» ضمن الإعدادات أدناه (الافتراضي $). يظهر في المبالغ المكتوبة داخل النصوص وبجانب المبالغ في لوحة المؤشرات والأدوات.
ar.Dates: date cells follow your computer's: التواريخ: خلايا التاريخ تتبع التنسيق الإقليمي لجهازك (مثل DD/MM/YYYY أو MM/DD/YYYY)، أما التواريخ المكتوبة داخل النصوص (المستندات والرسائل) فتتبع خانة «تنسيق التاريخ» ضمن الإعدادات أدناه.
ar.Google Sheets: upload this file to Googl: Google Sheets: ارفع هذا الملف إلى Google Drive وافتحه باستخدام Google Sheets؛ كل شيء يُحسب هناك أيضاً. قفل الأوراق لا ينتقل إلى Google Sheets، لذا اكتب في خلايا الإدخال فقط.
